summary: Russell's Mercedes machinery edges out Leclerc's Ferrari in Friday pace at Monza, setting up a high-speed duel between the two front-running teams on Italy's fastest circuit. McLaren's midfield assault and Red Bull's injury-depleted lineup create tactical opportunities in the pit lane, while oppressive heat conditions threaten to punish any setup miscalculations. A Russell or Leclerc victory tightens the championship fight dramatically, potentially reshaping the title battle heading into the final stretch of the season.
